title: Article platform overrides
description: Portal-owned data retained from legacy manually maintained articles. SAP material data remains in articles@1 and is never edited here.

_id.description: Deterministic portal override id derived from the legacy article id.

legacyId.description: Canonical BSON Extended JSON representation of the original legacy article id; preserves its type for audit and idempotent migration.

articleId.description: Matched articles@1 _id, or null until the legacy article is mapped.

legacyDocument.description: Complete original manually maintained document, including its BSON _id.
